source_candidate.candidate_scope: MCP Rust SDK client capability advertisement / sampling support

verified_claims.claim: Sampling support is an explicitly advertised client capability rather than something advertised by the default client handler automatically.
verified_claims.evidence: ClientCapabilities provides an explicit `enable_sampling()` builder, while the default ClientHandler::get_info() implementation returns `ClientInfo::default()`.

scope_limits: This verifies the capability-advertisement mechanism only.
It does not prove an end-to-end Chat-parity route.
It does not prove zero finite monthly/trial/paid quota dependency for a deployed provider.
It does not prove zero incremental cost beyond this repository-level mechanism.

phase1_assessment.reason: Primary-source support exists for explicit client capability advertisement, but end-to-end dependency elimination and zero-quota/zero-cost gates remain unverified.

continuation: Next invocation: reread the required control tuple, then verify exactly one currently surfaced downstream claim needed to close the remaining end-to-end or zero-quota/zero-cost gap; do not generalize this capability-level verification into full Phase-1 closure.
